title.narrative: Understanding the Gaps in Cancer Education and Awareness in Bangladesh and Finding Prospective Solutions: A Special Emphasis on Stigmas and Challenges Among Women

description.narrative: Despite progress in cancer management, Bangladesh faces formidable challenges to overcome stigma and misunderstanding around cancers. The challenge is even bigger for women who suffers from breast and ovarian cancers(1). Bangladesh has enormous problem regarding cancer awareness and education among general people. Proper research is also lacking here to meet these challenges. With the involvement of Sir Walter Bodmer from the University of oxford who has long experience in cancer research and science communication, and leading figures from Bangladesh, this project aims to bridge the gaps through trainings, seminars, social media awareness campaigns, and community outreach by targeting students, communities, and healthcare professionals. Specific strategies include understanding cancer stigmas, gaps in cancer education and cancer prevention, addressing doctor-patient relationship challenges with a practical manual, and engaging diverse speakers. The project plans events in educational institutions, villages, and conference halls/hospitals. Overall, the initiative seeks to enhance the understanding on cancer education, eradicate fear, and foster stronger connections between healthcare providers and patients.
